items.job: Replace one exhaust manifold with new gaskets and studs
items.note: Roughly double if both sides are cracked. Broken studs add labor.

items.job: Replace catalytic converter(s) and fix the cause of overheating
items.note: The V8 has four converters; cost climbs if more than one is damaged. Check emissions warranty coverage first.

items.job: Dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at a Nissan dealer. Check your VIN for open recalls.

items.job: Dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at a Nissan dealer. Check your VIN for open recalls.

items.t: Shifter can leave Park without the brake pressed (recall)
items.job: Dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at a Nissan dealer. Check your VIN for open recalls.

items.t: Oil cooler bolt can break and leak oil (recall)
items.job: Dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at a Nissan dealer. Check your VIN for open recalls.

items.job: Dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at a Nissan dealer. Check your VIN for open recalls.

items.job: Dealer recall repair

items.t: Check engine light for cooling fan speed (P0527)
items.job: Diagnose fan speed code; engine computer update or fan motor replacement
items.note: A software update may be all that is needed.

items.t: Check engine light for low fuel rail pressure (P0087)
items.job: Diagnose fuel pressure system and reflash engine computer
items.note: Parts cost applies only if a pump or sensor is faulty.

items.job: Test charging system and replace 12V battery
items.note: Add diagnosis time if a parasitic drain is found.

items.job: Replace automatic transmission with a remanufactured unit
items.note: One owner was quoted about $6,400. A used unit costs less.

items.t: Instrument cluster or computer communication failure
items.job: Diagnose network fault; repair wiring or replace instrument cluster
items.note: Wiring or connector repairs cost far less than a new cluster.

items.job: Replace steering gear and flush power steering fluid
Replace corroded steel brake lines and bleed brakes
items.note: Full-length line replacement on a long van takes longer.

items.job: Replace rear parking brake shoes and hardware
items.note: Rotors may also need replacing if the drum surface inside them is worn.

items.job: Replace front brake pads and rotors
Repair internal coolant leak (head gaskets or failed part)
items.note: If the engine was badly damaged, a replacement engine may be the better choice.

items.job: Reseal roof seams and treat rust
items.note: Rust that has gone through the metal needs body shop repair and costs more.

items.job: Clean and adjust or replace sliding door latch and cables

items.t: Heated seat element burns through the seat
items.job: Replace seat heater element and seat cushion cover
Replace cargo lamp bulbs

items.t: Engine stalls in gear or at idle
items.job: Diagnose stalling; clean throttle body and relearn idle
items.note: Cost rises if a sensor or fuel pump is the cause.

items.t: Transmission downshifts and lurches when stopping
items.job: Transmission software update and shift relearn
items.note: May be covered under warranty or a bulletin.
